chapter.heading: A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Who may
enter your sanctuary, Lord? Who may come into your presence on your holy mountain?

Those who
live without fault and do what is right, those who sincerely tell the truth.

They do
not slander, do not treat their neighbors badly, do not gossip about people they know.

They reject
people the Lord has rejected, but honor those who follow the Lord. They keep their promises even when it's hard to do. They don't change their minds.

They lend
money without charging interest. They don't take bribes to testify against the innocent. Those who act like this will never ever fall.
